subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix inbound image leaves agent turn unresolved; Matrix send queue hits fetch failed, then gateway reloads after ~60s

question: Should maintainers require a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room reproduction on current main before queueing a fix PR for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection shows the relevant paths remain, but the exact `fetch failed` plus unresolved turn plus gateway reload chain is not proven by existing tests or a current-main live run.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Use Docker with a Tuwunel encrypted Matrix room to capture sanitized before/after logs before assigning an implementation fix.

options.title: Queue a source-only fix
options.body: Attempt a narrow Matrix retry/error-classification patch from source evidence only, accepting a higher risk of fixing the wrong layer.

options.title: Wait for reporter repro logs
options.body: Ask the reporter for another current-main repro with maintainer-specified logging before spending live-QA time.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Use Docker with a Tuwunel encrypted Matrix room to capture sanitized before/after logs before assigning an implementation fix.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras has the broadest recent Matrix monitor/SDK/send migration history among the available routing candidates.
